answers.core: See previous answer, the core API does not expose setting the blend equation in any way other than the fixed blend modes.
answers.workaround: No, it can not be worked around as neither shaders, nor materials, not `RenderingServer` allow direct manipulation of the blend equations. Everything must go through the `CanvasItemMaterial` enum `BlendMode`.

title: Separate blend mode from premultiplied alpha in CanvasItemMaterial
